name: One Way Love ~Mint-chan Monogatari~
original_name: One Way Love ～ミントちゃん物語～
source:
It is a world where robots have become widespread. Main character lives with his maid robot Mint. He may choose to stay alone or seek love with Mint or some other girl. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在这个世界里，机器人已经广泛普及。主角与女仆机器人敏特一起生活。他可以选择独自一人，也可以追求与敏特或其他女孩之间的爱情。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
